name: ONEWISH Mushroom Nightstand Lamp
shortDescription: A translucent mushroom-style nightstand lamp for adding warm amber glow, soft reflections, and cozy decor energy to bedrooms, side tables, and reading corners.
longDescription: The ONEWISH Mushroom Nightstand Lamp is a cozy room decor pick for anyone who likes warm, glassy accent lighting with a playful mushroom silhouette. The listing imagery highlights a translucent glass mushroom table lamp, a warm included bulb, soothing light, and dimmer-style brightness control. It is especially easy to imagine on a bedside table, small reading nook, dresser, or cozy apartment side table where the lamp can double as decor even when it is not the main room light. This Forever Memory draft uses an original editorial placeholder image rather than Amazon listing artwork. Before buying, check the current Amazon listing for the exact finish, bulb details, dimmer behavior, switch or cord setup, dimensions, price, delivery option, and availability.
